title: The Last Shelter
intro: Wrath of God threatens your entire battlefield. Keep two creatures after it resolves.
hint: Activated abilities stay on the stack even when their source has been sacrificed.
explanation: Sacrifice Selfless Spirit as a cost. Its ability gives your other creatures indestructible before Wrath of God destroys creatures. Sacrifice itself does not count as destruction.

title: One Breath Left
intro: You are at 2 life. Lightning Bolt is targeting you for 3 damage.
hint: You can stop the spell, or gain life before the damage resolves.
explanation: Either Counterspell targeting Lightning Bolt or Healing Salve targeting yourself keeps you alive. Both resolve on top of Bolt.

title: A Bear Against Lightning
intro: Your 2/2 Grizzly Bears is targeted by Lightning Bolt. Keep it on the battlefield.
hint: Creature damage is compared to toughness when state-based actions are checked.
explanation: Giant Growth makes Grizzly Bears 5/5 until end of turn. Three damage is marked, but less than five toughness, so it survives.

title: Spell or Creature?
intro: Wrath of God is on the stack. Which counter actually has a legal target?
hint: Read the targets: Wrath of God is a sorcery, not a creature spell.
explanation: Negate counters the noncreature spell Wrath of God. Essence Scatter cannot target it. Casting requires both legal timing and a legal target.

title: Hexproof Arrives Late
intro: Murder targets your Hill Giant. Its target was legal when cast; can you change that?
hint: Increasing toughness cannot stop a spell that says “destroy.”
explanation: Heroic Intervention gives your Hill Giant hexproof. On resolution, Murder checks its target again, finds it illegal, and does not resolve. Giant Growth does not prevent destruction.

title: The Final Exchange
intro: Your Bolt would win at 3 opponent life. Their Counterspell stops it; another Bolt threatens your 2 life.
hint: You need BOTH survival and a clear path for your own lethal Bolt. Choose your Dispel target carefully.
explanation: Gain 3 life with Healing Salve and use Dispel on the opposing Counterspell, not their Bolt. Their Bolt deals 3 but you survive; your Bolt then resolves and wins.

title: The Narrow Shelter
intro: A destroy spell threatens your Giant. A board wipe waits beneath it. Rescue your Giant from BOTH effects.
hint: Sacrifice the Spirit to defeat the board wipe. Counter the direct removal; a toughness pump cannot stop Murder.
explanation: Selfless Spirit grants indestructible to the remaining team, blocking Wrath of God. Counterspell must stop Murder, because indestructible alone does not answer targeted exile or every removal effect.

title: Three Necessary Answers
intro: A board wipe, lethal burn and targeted removal share the stack. Save the Giant and your life.
hint: You need all three different responses. Protection from destruction is not life gain.
explanation: The Spirit must be sacrificed to protect the Giant from Wrath of God. Healing Salve raises your life before the Bolt, and Counterspell removes Murder before it can destroy the Giant.

title: One Spell Too Many
intro: Your lethal Bolt is countered, while two hostile burn spells threaten you. You have three responses and only three mana.
hint: You must stop their Counterspell AND one burn spell, while gaining enough life to survive the other.
explanation: Healing Salve raises you to five. One Dispel protects your winning Bolt and the other counters a damage spell, leaving enough life to survive and deliver lethal damage.

title: Mana Under Fire
intro: Two Lightning Bolts face you while a Counterspell guards against your lethal Bolt. Manage your lands and choose your line.
hint: Two life-gain spells plus a counter for the opposing Counterspell is one solution. Or find another legal answer with your mana.
explanation: Two Healing Salves allow you to take both Bolts, and a counterspell clears the path for your own Bolt. Different legal counter and mana allocations can also work.

title: Protect the Protection
intro: Your Heroic Intervention is ALREADY on the stack—an opponent is countering it. A lethal Bolt is on top, with Wrath and Swords waiting below.
hint: Heal to survive the Bolt. Counter the spell that would stop your already-cast Heroic Intervention.
explanation: Healing Salve keeps you alive through Bolt. Dispel counters the opposing Counterspell, allowing your Heroic Intervention to resolve. Hexproof invalidates Swords to Plowshares and indestructible shields creatures from Wrath.

title: The Fractured Stack
intro: Three enemy Bolts threaten your single life. Their Counterspell stops your winning Bolt. Four precise responses are needed.
hint: Gain six life, stop one of their Bolts, and counter their Counterspell; two damaging Bolts can then resolve safely.
explanation: Both Healing Salves add six life, reaching seven. Use one Dispel to stop their Counterspell and another to stop any of their Bolts. Two Bolts still deal six, leaving you alive at one, and your Bolt wins.

title: The Seedling Shield
intro: Blossoming Defense increases Grizzly Bears to 4/4; three damage does not destroy it.
hint: Hexproof alone cannot undo marked damage, but increasing toughness can save the creature.
explanation: Blossoming Defense increases Grizzly Bears to 4/4; three damage does not destroy it. Hexproof and a toughness increase are different tools.

title: A Thorn in the Blade
intro: Cast Blossoming Defense onto Savannah Lions.
hint: Murder cares about destroy, not toughness. You need the ability that also grants hexproof.
explanation: Cast Blossoming Defense onto Savannah Lions. Once it gains hexproof, the opposing Murder has an illegal target on resolution.

title: Dive Beneath the Spell
intro: Dive Down makes your Hill Giant hexproof and increases its toughness by three; Murder cannot resolve against it.
hint: Choose a card you can actually cast. Dive Down grants hexproof, not just toughness.
explanation: Dive Down makes your Hill Giant hexproof and increases its toughness by three; Murder cannot resolve against it.

title: A Wall of Lightning
intro: Cast Titanic Growth on the Bear and Blossoming Defense on Savannah Lions to keep both creatures alive through their individual damage spells.
hint: Each creature must live through a different damage spell. Two green responses and three mana.
explanation: Cast Titanic Growth on the Bear and Blossoming Defense on Savannah Lions to keep both creatures alive through their individual damage spells.

title: Blackwater Crossing
intro: Blossoming Defense saves Grizzly Bears through the Bolt; Dive Down grants hexproof to the Giant so Swords to Plowshares cannot exile it.
hint: Indestructible does not stop exile. Hexproof can make an existing target illegal.
explanation: Blossoming Defense saves Grizzly Bears through the Bolt; Dive Down grants hexproof to the Giant so Swords to Plowshares cannot exile it.

title: The Three-Color Gate
intro: Titanic Growth raises Grizzly Bears toughness above Bolt damage; Cancel counters Wrath of God.
hint: You must prevent the wipe and the damage. A creature-only counter cannot stop Wrath of God.
explanation: Titanic Growth raises Grizzly Bears toughness above Bolt damage; Cancel counters Wrath of God. Essence Scatter cannot counter a sorcery.

title: Two Blades, Two Defenses
intro: Grant Grizzly Bears hexproof with Blossoming Defense and Hill Giant hexproof with Dive Down.
hint: Both targeted removal spells must lose their legal target. Pure toughness is not enough.
explanation: Grant Grizzly Bears hexproof with Blossoming Defense and Hill Giant hexproof with Dive Down. Both black removal spells then fail on resolution.

title: Ward the Pack
intro: Sacrifice Selfless Spirit to protect the Giant from Wrath and cast Dive Down on the Giant so Doom Blade has an illegal target.
hint: One ability handles the board wipe; another response blanks the targeted removal.
explanation: Sacrifice Selfless Spirit to protect the Giant from Wrath and cast Dive Down on the Giant so Doom Blade has an illegal target.

title: The Triple Firewall
intro: Gain life with Healing Salve, give the Giant hexproof with Dive Down, and sacrifice Selfless Spirit to survive the Wrath.
hint: You have three different problems: lethal damage, targeted removal, and a mass destroy effect.
explanation: Gain life with Healing Salve, give the Giant hexproof with Dive Down, and sacrifice Selfless Spirit to survive the Wrath. Every response matters.

title: Unbroken Intervention
intro: Healing Salve saves you from Lightning Bolt, Cancel stops the opposing Counterspell so Heroic Intervention resolves, and Blossoming Defense gives the Giant hexproof against Swords to Plowshares.
hint: Heroic Intervention is already on the stack. Save it from the Counterspell and stop the earlier exile.
explanation: Healing Salve saves you from Lightning Bolt, Cancel stops the opposing Counterspell so Heroic Intervention resolves, and Blossoming Defense gives the Giant hexproof against Swords to Plowshares.

title: The Double Ember
intro: Gain three life and counter either Lightning Bolt or Shock.
hint: Healing Salve alone leaves you at zero after all damage. Stop one burn spell too.
explanation: Gain three life and counter either Lightning Bolt or Shock. The remaining burn spell is survivable.

title: The Rift Engine
intro: Two Healing Salves, a Dispel on the enemy Counterspell, and another Dispel on one damaging spell let the original Bolt defeat your opponent.
hint: Save your own Bolt by countering their counter, heal twice, then prevent one of the lethal spells from resolving.
explanation: Two Healing Salves, a Dispel on the enemy Counterspell, and another Dispel on one damaging spell let the original Bolt defeat your opponent.

title: The Fortress Keeper
intro: Sacrifice the Spirit to give your Bear indestructible, and use Blossoming Defense to make it an illegal target for Doom Blade.
hint: The board wipe and direct removal are two different threats. You need both defenses.
explanation: Sacrifice the Spirit to give your Bear indestructible, and use Blossoming Defense to make it an illegal target for Doom Blade.

title: Mercy at the Breach
intro: Healing Salve raises your life above the burn threshold; Blossoming Defense grants the Giant hexproof and invalidates Swords to Plowshares.
hint: You cannot survive the damage or stop the exile with just one card.
explanation: Healing Salve raises your life above the burn threshold; Blossoming Defense grants the Giant hexproof and invalidates Swords to Plowshares.

title: Three Doors to Survival
intro: Selfless Spirit prevents Wrath destroying the Giant, Dive Down gives it hexproof from Murder, and Healing Salve saves you from Shock.
hint: One creature can handle the wipe, but not the murder or your nearly empty life total.
explanation: Selfless Spirit prevents Wrath destroying the Giant, Dive Down gives it hexproof from Murder, and Healing Salve saves you from Shock.

title: The Final Channel
intro: Save the Giant from Doom Blade using Blossoming Defense; gain life before Lightning Strike; counter the enemy Counterspell with Dispel so your lethal Bolt resolves.
hint: Winning the damage race is not enough; the Giant must also stay on the battlefield.
explanation: Save the Giant from Doom Blade using Blossoming Defense; gain life before Lightning Strike; counter the enemy Counterspell with Dispel so your lethal Bolt resolves.

title: Keep the Banner Standing
intro: Sacrifice the Spirit, use Blossoming Defense on the Giant, gain life with Healing Salve, and Dispel the enemy Counterspell to win while keeping the Giant alive.
hint: You need to protect the Giant, keep enough life, and preserve your own lethal spell.
explanation: Sacrifice the Spirit, use Blossoming Defense on the Giant, gain life with Healing Salve, and Dispel the enemy Counterspell to win while keeping the Giant alive.

title: The Last Response
intro: Give the Giant indestructible and hexproof, heal for three, counter one lethal burn spell and the opposing Counterspell.
hint: Exactly five responses: preserve the Giant, outlive one burn spell, stop the other, and free your lethal Bolt.
explanation: Give the Giant indestructible and hexproof, heal for three, counter one lethal burn spell and the opposing Counterspell. Resolve the original Bolt to finish the fifth chapter.
